obligations.limitation: Predicate agreement depends on faithful observation mapping; the adapter must be tested separately.
obligations.requirement: Select exactly the least required dependency closure, including the root, without duplicates.

obligations.limitation: Reference procedure is required; its implementation is deferred.
obligations.requirement: Preserve the documented traversal and record ordering.

obligations.limitation: The predicate compares supplied digests. The independent check must establish projection completeness and full raw-record equality.
obligations.requirement: Retain complete selected operation records and one digest per selected ID.

obligations.limitation: Predicate agreement depends on faithful observation mapping; the adapter must be tested separately.
obligations.requirement: Retain all decisions belonging to selected operations.

obligations.limitation: Predicate agreement depends on faithful observation mapping; the adapter must be tested separately.
obligations.requirement: Partition available operations into selected and explicitly omitted IDs.

obligations.limitation: Independent comparison must inspect full raw records, not only the projected IDs.
obligations.requirement: Select and preserve exactly the required state records.

obligations.limitation: Literal keys named evidence_ids do not select evidence. Source hashes do not authenticate source provenance.
obligations.requirement: Select and preserve exactly the sources referenced by selected schema metadata.

obligations.limitation: Predicate agreement depends on faithful observation mapping; the adapter must be tested separately.
obligations.requirement: Retain the input specification identity in the context.

obligations.limitation: The independent encoder must retain the final newline and counter fields; predicate checks do not validate that encoder.
obligations.requirement: Both counters equal independently measured compact JSON UTF-8 bytes and do not exceed the requested budget.

obligations.limitation: Boundary equality does not exclude transient writes that are later restored, or prove absence of aliasing.
obligations.requirement: Preserve invocation argument values at observed completion boundaries.

obligations.limitation: The full specification validator has additional earlier failures outside this profile domain. Outcome mapping must use the observed exception code.
obligations.requirement: Within the declared domain, validate required references before budget validity, then resolve selection, then check package capacity.

obligations.limitation: Requires independent package construction and structured exception details, both deferred.
obligations.requirement: Reject a non-fitting package with the exact required size; never reject a fitting valid invocation as CONTEXT_BUDGET.

obligations.limitation: Excluded from mandatory scoped acceptance. Contract verdicts retain unknown for this opaque obligation.
obligations.requirement: No external effects occur during candidate invocation.

exclusions: Malformed schemas, stale input identities, invalid expression types, noninteger or nonfinite budgets, and non-JSON arguments remain outside this bounded profile.
Concurrency, arbitrary external effects, transient writes restored before capture, post-return aliasing, universal refinement, and agent coding advantage are not established.
input_domain: Portable v0.3 intended or observed invocation specifications with valid structure, identity, types, and references, except that required dependency targets may be absent.
Selection is a nonempty string containing an operation ID, valid alias, or absent selection. Budgets are safe integers, including values outside 1 through 2097152.
Single synchronous invocation over in-memory JSON values. Schema work limits and expression limits remain those of v0.3.
